sql: with tw as ( select market_ticker t, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser, pnl::float p, assumed_price ap from paper_trades where strategy='Fmmsell10_pt4' and pnl is not null and created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z'), ord as (select distinct market_ticker t from live_orders where strategy='Fmmsell10' and action='buy' and created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z'), fil as (select distinct f.market_ticker t from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Fmmsell10' and o.action='buy' and o.created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z'), b as (select tw.*, case when tw.t in (select t from fil) then '1filled' when tw.t in (select t from ord) then '2ordered_unfilled' else '3never_ordered' end bucket from tw) select coalesce(ser,'ALL') ser, bucket, count(*) n, round(avg((p>0)::int)*100,1) win_pct, round(avg(p)*100,2) c_per, round(sum(p)::numeric,2) usd, sum((p<0)::int) losers, round(coalesce(sum(p) filter (where p<0),0)::numeric,2) loser_usd from b group by grouping sets ((bucket),(ser,bucket)) having count(*)>=15 or ser is null order by ser nulls first, bucket
